about: Lanchester (mil) wording overrides, applied by build_curriculum.py to every tutor-facing text of library/military/syllabus/curriculum.json: item names and 'teach', test-out and brief titles and reasons, reading 'why', 'focus' and 'topic' (never a publication's title, authors or org). Plain substring replacements, in order; the build fails when a 'from' no longer matches anything, so a stale entry is noticed. Why: on 28.10 the tutor refused to write lessons, and the trigger was operational phrasing reaching every lesson-part prompt (CLAUDE.md, 'סירוב של Claude'). The same topics stay, at the same depth, in the engineering and analytical register of the fixed rules: physics, systems engineering, measurement, modeling, case analysis, defense analysis as an academic discipline.
